decision: Recommend one bounded paired local implementation: M-ID f1 versus legalizer O-tail-prepared; reject automatic lower-state/lower-cost rationale. No implementation executed this round.

accepted_designs.M: fixed nonqueued same-clock f1 start capture; qualified independent normal COPY pair plus S1 root page in DRAM; ID-only P1 consume at selector output-spill input accept; timeout disables gate but not association; held/READY preserved
accepted_designs.O_local: tail-only dynamic source cap; read/write decoupled; existing metadata FIFO nonempty gates atomic descriptor acceptance; true accepted RLAST releases next descriptor; no separate pacing state required
accepted_designs.O_prepared: same tail split with ahead translation; L1 fixed ID/offset/len recognized before TC physical firstVALID; existing AR FIFO head/PA/COMPLETE hold; reuse inactive RAW metadata bit for L0 marker; one backend sticky bit and completion level to TC; VALID and read-pop gate together
accepted_designs.O_job: whole-job128 is a separate program with changed prefix and transaction counts, no reuse of tail-only2058

root_integration_findings: S1 first PTE must be routed to target DRAM; non-DRAM successful P1 then DRAM P2 is not solved by retire/active. Restrict qualification from known root table page, no future PTE data.
Local descriptor release and global physical readiness are distinct; TL in banked N-disabled configuration blocks new ordinary requests during active V walk. PN bypass requires qualified DC/4K hit.
Ordinary prepared version can reuse current TC storage, so no mandatory new header FIFO or whole splitter cost.
Actual shared selector is round-robin; model DS-first/F4 requires common paid adaptation if instantiated.
Old a_split occupies the shared data server, not merely child publication. Old2060/2058 cannot be transplanted to native f1/empty/TC wiring.

contribution_levels.functional: source-bound executable designs, no RTL validation
contribution_levels.relative_difference: actual control/translation/return paths differ; net superiority not established
contribution_levels.practical_value: unknown; no measured native cost/performance/CPU/memory advantage
contribution_levels.independent_prior_increment: no exclusive scheduling algorithm; narrow early-interface contribution hypothesis remains unverified
